description:
Embark on an exciting journey exploring the beauty of Canada. 
Get ready to search for various objects, play exciting mini-games and collect souvenirs.
It is an exciting adventure offering many ways to find hidden objects and a wide selection of exciting mini-games.
You will be able to visit majestic mountains, conquer Arctic expanses, 
immerse yourself in the beauty of Canadian lakes, explore great cities, including Toronto and Vancouver, 
and enjoy the nature of national parks. 

The game will give you the opportunity to use your skills and knowledge to complete mini-games and find all the hidden objects.

The collector 's edition includes: 
- 10 additional locations 
- 10 additional mini-games, as well as 12 puzzles for real fans 
- Shop with Canadian souvenirs
name: Around the World 2: Travel to Canada Collector's Edition
